I'm just gonna say it: morning people are a different species. How do you guys do it? Seriously, I want to know! My coworker gets up at five a.m. to go for a run. Five! In the morning! By choice! Meanwhile, I've hit the snooze button so many times my alarm just gives up on me. I've tried everything to become a morning person. I've set my coffee maker on a timer. I've put my phone across the room. I even bought one of those sunrise alarm clocks that's supposed to gently wake you up with light. You know what happened? I slept right through it. The light was just shining on my closed eyelids like a really peaceful lamp. My mom keeps telling me I just need to go to bed earlier, but here's the thing: I'm not tired at ten p.m.! My brain decides that's the perfect time to think about every embarrassing thing I've ever done. So yeah, I'll just keep being a night owl. We're cooler anyway!
